entry.title: European summer gives the Magnum Ice Cream Company a boost in Q3
entry.summary: The Magnum Ice Cream Company has reported a strong Q3, boosted in part by the extended European summer. The company saw significant growth in key brands, with Magnum and Heartbrand in double-digit growth.

entry.title: Mondelēz turns Toblerone into flavour innovation engine
entry.summary: Toblerone has launched a limited-edition Pistachio Gelato flavour at Istanbul Airport as Mondelēz leans into flavour innovation, travel retail exclusives and destination-inspired confectionery.

entry.title: Hershey hopes Halloween candy can ward off declining volume fears
entry.summary: Hershey bets on last-minute Halloween candy sales as inflation, higher gas prices and consumer pressures weigh on volumes despite an earnings beat.

entry.title: From cultivated beef to fermented soy: Bezos-backed protein innovators target cost and scale
entry.summary: Aleph Farms and Mottainai Food Tech secure S$1m each to scale cultivated meat and fermented protein, targeting cost, resilience and commercial growth.

entry.title: 3 ways Google DeepMind is using AI to reshape the food system
entry.summary: From AlphaFold and disease-resistant crops to virtual cells, Google DeepMind is exploring how AI can accelerate agricultural and food innovation.

entry.title: Could enzymes be the key to clean-label functionality?
entry.summary: Enzymes are used throughout the food industry for a whole plethora of different functionalities. Because they are catalysts, they often do not need to appear in a food's ingredients list. Therefore, they can be considered clean-label alternatives to additives.

entry.title: Mondelēz Q3 profits surge amid surprise acquisition
entry.summary: Mondelēz returns to volume-led growth as Q3 profits surge, shareholders rewarded and Undercover Snacks acquisition signals expansion into permissible indulgence.

entry.title: Thanksgiving flavours go snack-sized
entry.summary: Campbell’s Thanksgiving findings reveal how comfort flavours and easy recipes give snack producers more ways to reach shoppers before, during and after dinner.

entry.title: Deposit Return Scheme: What drinks businesses need to know
entry.summary: Drinks manufacturers must prepare for the UK's 2027 Deposit Return Scheme, including new packaging specifications, labelling requirements, producer fees and compliance obligations.

entry.title: DoorDash’s Instacart deal promises CPG better ad reach, raises antitrust concerns
entry.summary: DoorDash’s $17 billion Instacart deal promises broader reach and advertising tools for CPG brands, but critics warn of a food delivery monopoly.

entry.title: What comes next for reformulation, UPFs and retail?
entry.summary: The month’s top-read FoodNavigator-USA stories explored how regulators and manufacturers are tackling sodium reduction, defining ultra-processed foods and preparing for the next generation of retail.

entry.title: Inside food and beverage’s AI-powered future
entry.summary: AI is reshaping food and beverage, from factory automation and product innovation to ingredient discovery, supply chains and personalised consumer engagement. Explore what comes next.

entry.title: 7 consumer shifts that will define food and drink in 2027
entry.summary: Consumers are changing fast. From GLP-1s and climate concern to sustainability and shared living, these seven shifts will redefine food and drink by 2027

entry.title: Coca-Cola, Pepsi lose brand value as Nongfu Spring surges
entry.summary: Coca-Cola and Pepsi retain the top beverage brand value spots

entry.title: Gut as core: Danone advances health span, early life nutrition in new China lab
entry.summary: Danone has built a new research and innovation center in Shanghai, China, to advance research and product solutions to meet consumer needs in the core areas of the gut microbiome, healthspan, and early-life nutrition.

entry.title: The race to replace artificial colours intensifies
entry.summary: From Nestlé to Mars, major manufacturers are reformulating with natural colours. But can they match the performance of synthetic dyes?

entry.title: Oatly to raise US prices in 2027, weighs increases in Europe
entry.summary: Oatly plans US price increases in 2027 and is considering hikes in Europe as higher fuel costs squeeze profits. A US fiber drink launch is set for January.

entry.title: Whole Foods leads Amazon’s fresh push as delivery gets faster, cheaper
entry.summary: Amazon sees fresh-food delivery as a key growth opportunity, with faster fulfillment lowering costs and grocery shoppers spending across categories.

entry.title: European supermarket fridges hit with suspected cyber attack
entry.summary: Suspected cyber attack hits supermarket refrigeration systems across Europe, raising fridge and freezer temperatures and renewing concerns over food-sector cyber resilience

entry.title: Mondelēz sues British chocolate brand in Toblerone trademark dispute
entry.summary: Mondelēz subsidiary, Kraft Foods Schweiz Holding GmbH, has launched legal action against vegan chocolate maker Catherine’s Originals, alleging its O’bar infringes Toblerone’s iconic shape trademark. Catherine’s Originals denies the claims and vows to defend its position.
